prompt: Create an original 180 second contemporary organ music instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: pipe organ, low strings. Style: slow pedal tones and open suspended harmony. Tempo approximately 48 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and expressive classical piece featuring a solo cello with piano accompaniment. The cello carries a rich, resonant melody that evokes a range of emotions from somber reflection to moments of passionate intensity. The piano provides a supportive harmonic foundation and occasional counter-melodies. The tempo is generally slow to moderate, allowing the intricate melodies to unfold gracefully. The overall mood is contemplative and elegant, suitable for dramatic or reflective scenes.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而富有表现力的古典乐曲，以大提琴独奏为主，钢琴伴奏。大提琴演奏着丰富、共鸣的旋律，唤起从沉思反省到激情迸发等多种情感。钢琴提供和声支持和偶尔的对位旋律。节奏通常缓慢到中等，使复杂的旋律得以优雅地展开。整体氛围沉思而优雅，适合戏剧性或反思性的场景。
